In 7 episodes, Crash Course Scientific Thinking will teach learners the foundational principles underlying scientific thought, pulling back the curtain on processes like peer review, interrogating what makes sources reliable (or not), unpacking how consensus is reached, and revealing how scientific understanding changes over time. Ultimately, learners will gain the ability to think more critically about the scientific information they encounter in their everyday lives. 

Series Objectives
- Describe the dynamic, communal nature of science, articulating the roles of uncertainty and consensus.
- Explain the role of peer review and replication in science.
- Unpack the potential for bias and error in science and understand its self-correction mechanisms.
- Understand the role of specialization in scientific expertise.
- Interpret primary, secondary, and tertiary sources, and use lateral reading to verify claims.
- Understand basic statistical language used to describe scientific findings.

movies.title: Crash Course Geology
movies.description:
In 25 episodes, we’re going to learn about geology—the study of Earth’s physical structure and processes. Our host, Sage, will teach you about the geological forces and cycles that shape our planet’s past, present, and future. 

This content is based on an introductory university-level curriculum. By the end of this course, you should be able to: 

Trace Earth’s development from its earliest periods to its current structure
Understand the forces of plate tectonics and how they shape Earth’s landscape
Describe the formation of geologic elements like minerals, rocks, and gems 
Identify geologic forces and cycles that impact the earth, while dispelling myths about extreme geological hazards
Learn what geology reveals about Earth’s distant past and what it can teach us about our current changing climate
Explore the geology of other planets within the context of Earth’s unique and common qualities and phenomena
Become familiar with different specialities within geology and what different types of geologists do

Key texts cited include:
Marshak, Stephen. 2021. Earth: Portrait of a Planet, Seventh Edition.
Babcock, Loren E. 2009. Gemstones and Precious Metals.

movies.title: Computer Basics
movies.description:
In this video playlist, you’ll get to know the basics of getting started using computers. Visit https://www.gcflearnfree.org/computerbasics/ for our text-based tutorial.

With this video series, you’ll learn more about the types of computers and operating systems in use today. You'll also gain a better understanding of the basic parts of a computer, how applications are used, connecting to the Internet, and more.

We hope you enjoy!

movies.title: Programming in Python
movies.description:
In this course, you will be introduced to foundational programming skills with basic Python Syntax. You’ll learn how to use code to solve problems. You’ll dive deep into the Python ecosystem and learn popular modules, libraries and tools for Python. 
You’ll also get hands-on with objects, classes and methods in Python, and utilize variables, data types, control flow and loops, functions and data structures. You’ll learn how to recognize and handle errors and you’ll write unit tests for your Python code and practice test-driven development.
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
•	Prepare your computer system for Python programming
•	Show understanding of Python syntax and how to control the flow of code
•	Demonstrate knowledge of how to handle errors and exceptions
•	Explain object-oriented programming and the major concepts associated with it
•	Explain the importance of testing in Python, and when to apply particular methods
This is a beginner course for learners who would like to prepare themselves for a career in back-end development or database engineering. To succeed in this course, you do not need prior web development experience, only basic internet navigation skills and an eagerness to get started with coding.

movies.title: Basic Computer Course Playlist Theory with Practical
Programming for Kids and Beginners: Learn to Code in Scratch 3.0
movies.description:
Now with Scratch 3.0: learn to program, create games, have fun in Scratch! For kids and beginners, parents and teachers!

In this course, we'll learn to code, starting from the basic blocks. No kidding! Scratch, the programming language we use (developed by MIT), is so fun that it makes programming seem like a game.

We'll learn by doing. The course is designed so that you create the games and applications with your own two hands. But what makes this course truly unique is the teaching method I've used live for almost 4 years. We learn a variety of computer science topics, but we hide the complexity behind characters, animations, analogies and fun!

That's because, in these carefully designed lessons, we train our intuition to make sense of what we want to achieve and how to get there. This will help you quickly master the basics. After this course, you'll learn text-based programming languages at a blazing speed and quickly make sense of any piece of code.

The content is designed to be fun! We learn to create animations and cool effects and we create clones of some of the most popular games: Flappy Bird, Duck Hunt or Pac-Man. The games are handpicked to optimize learning computer science topics while having fun along the way. I will also update the course on a regular basis with new content - and challenges!

This course is designed for

parents or teachers who want to give their children the best skills and most fun
kids and beginners who want to learn to code games
anyone new to programming who doesn't know where to start
I can't wait to have you in the course!

The course is regularly updated with new material, tips and tricks that you can use in your games and projects!

Who this course is for:
Children (from 7-8 years)
Absolute beginners in programming and computer science

movies.title: English for Career Development
movies.description:
Welcome to English for Career Development, a course created by the University of Pennsylvania, and funded by the U.S. Department of State Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs, Office of English Language Programs. 
To enroll in this course for free, click on “Enroll now” and then select "Full Course. No certificate."
This course is designed for non-native English speakers who are interested in advancing their careers in the global marketplace. In this course, you will learn about the job search, application, and interview process in the United States, while comparing and contrasting the same process in your home country. This course will also give you the opportunity to explore your global career path, while building your vocabulary and improving your language skills to achieve your professional goals. The first unit in this course will introduce the U.S. job application process and provide strategies for identifying the jobs that match your interests and skills. Unit 2 will take you through the steps necessary to produce a professional-looking resume. In unit 3, you will work to develop a clear and concise cover letter. The final unit of the course focuses on networking and interview skills.
Anyone may take this course for free. If you want to get a Coursera Verified Certificate for free, please fill out the Financial Aid form.
 Unless otherwise noted, all course materials are available for re-use, repurposing and free distribution under a Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution license.
Supplemental reading materials were provided by Newsela, which publishes daily news articles at a level that's just right for each English language learner.

movies.title: Excel Basics for Data Analysis
movies.description:
Spreadsheet tools like Excel are an essential tool for working with data - whether for data analytics, business, marketing, or research. This course is designed to give you a basic working knowledge of Excel and how to use it for analyzing data. 
 
This course is suitable for those who are interested in pursuing a career in data analysis or data science, as well as anyone looking to use Excel for data analysis in their own domain. No prior experience with spreadsheets or coding is required - all you need is a device with a modern web browser and the ability to create a Microsoft account to access Excel online at no cost. If you have a desktop version of Excel, you can also easily follow along with the course. 
 
Throughout this course, you'll gain valuable experience working with data sets and spreadsheets. We'll start by introducing you to spreadsheets like Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, and show you how to load data from multiple formats. From there, you'll learn how to perform basic data wrangling and cleansing tasks using functions, and expand your knowledge of data analysis through the use of filtering, sorting, and pivot tables. 
 
There is a strong focus on practice and applied learning in this course. With each lab, you'll have the opportunity to manipulate data and gain hands-on experience using Excel. You'll learn how to clean and format your data efficiently, and convert it into a pivot table to make it more organized and readable. The final project will allow you to showcase your newly acquired data analysis skills by working with real data sets and spreadsheets. 
 
By the end of this course, you'll have a solid foundation in using Excel for data analysis. You'll have worked with multiple data sets and spreadsheets, and will have the skills and knowledge needed to effectively clean and analyze data without having to learn any code. So let's get started!

movies.title: Programming with JavaScript
movies.description: JavaScript is the programming language that powers the modern web. In this course, you will learn the basic concepts of web development with JavaScript. You will work with functions, objects, arrays, variables, data types, the HTML DOM, and much more. You will learn how to use JavaScript and discover interactive possibilities with modern JavaScript technologies. Finally, you will learn about the practice of testing code and how to write a unit test using Jest.

movies.title: Careers in business, marketing and finance
Speak English Professionally: In Person, Online & On the Phone
movies.description:
Do you want to speak better English? This course will help you reach that goal. Speak English Professionally: In person, Online and On the Phone will boost your English speaking skills. In this 5 week course, you will learn how to identify and make a strong personal introduction. You will develop and demonstrate the speaking skills for group discussions: how to agree or disagree, how to clarify, restate and summarize. You will review and practice how to give information and respond to requests on the phone. You will study and role play effective interviewing. You will prepare and give a sales “pitch”, introducing a product or service. Throughout the course, you will adjust how you speak English and you will become more fluent and accurate when you speak. You will demonstrate culturally appropriate body language and tone. As you work through the course, you will complete self- and peer-evaluations. Through a combination of lectures, comprehension and vocabulary quizzes, practice and performance, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to communicate well in English, anywhere in the world.	
By the end of this course you will:
• Change how you speak English
•	Improve your pronunciation and fluency 
• Increase your English vocabulary 
•	Identify how culture influences your speech
•	Use culture to help you speak correctly 
•	Demonstrate the best body language for different cultural settings
•	Know statements, questions and responses for different settings and situations

movies.title: Linux System Programming and Introduction to Buildroot
movies.description:
This course provides an overview of System Programming for the Linux operating system, or software which is interfacing directly with the Linux Kernel and C library. The basic components of a Linux Embedded System, including kernel and root filesystem details are discussed. The Buildroot build system is introduced, which students use to build their own custom Embedded Linux system through programming assignments.
Linux System Programming and Introduction to Buildroot can also be taken for academic credit as ECEA 5305, part of CU Boulder’s Master of Science in Electrical Engineering.

movies.title: Databases and SQL for Data Science with Python
movies.description:
Working knowledge of SQL (or Structured Query Language) is a must for data professionals like Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Engineers. Much of the world's data resides in databases. SQL is a powerful language used for communicating with and extracting data from databases.
In this course you will learn SQL inside out- from the very basics of Select statements to
advanced concepts like JOINs. 
You will: 
-write foundational SQL statements like: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE 
-filter result sets, use WHERE, COUNT, DISTINCT, and LIMIT clauses 
-differentiate between DML & DDL 
-CREATE, ALTER, DROP and load tables 
-use string patterns and ranges; ORDER and GROUP result sets, and built-in database functions
-build sub-queries and query data from multiple tables 
-access databases as a data scientist using Jupyter notebooks with SQL and Python
-work with advanced concepts like Stored Procedures, Views, ACID Transactions, Inner & Outer JOINs through hands-on labs and projects
You will practice building SQL queries, work with real databases on the Cloud, and use real data science tools. 
In the final project you’ll analyze multiple real-world datasets to demonstrate your skills.

movies.title: Excel Skills for Business: Essentials
movies.description:
In this first course of the specialization, 'Excel Skills for Business: Essentials', you will master the fundamental capabilities of Microsoft Excel. Over six weeks, you will gain the confidence to expertly navigate the Excel user interface, perform essential calculations using formulas and functions, professionally format spreadsheets, and create impactful data visualizations with charts and graphs.
This course is designed for aspiring business professionals, students, and anyone looking to enhance their digital skills. Whether you are new to Excel or self-taught and aiming to solidify your foundational knowledge for greater efficiency and productivity, this program provides a robust starting point. You will solve a variety of practical business problems, applying learned Excel skills and techniques through downloadable workbooks and real-world data sets.
To succeed in this course, no prior Excel experience is required. You will develop highly valuable spreadsheet software skills, positioning yourself for success in today's rapidly evolving digital job market.

movies.title: Introduction To Cybersecurity Course Online
movies.description: The Foundations of Cybersecurity Program is designed to introduce you to one of the most critical and fast-growing fields in today’s digital world. As technology continues to shape businesses, governments, and everyday life, the need for cybersecurity professionals who can protect data, systems, and people has never been greater.

movies.title: Nina and the Neurons - Go Digital
Introduction to HTML, CSS, & JavaScript
movies.description:
Want to take the first steps to become a Web Developer? This course will help you discover the languages, frameworks, and tools you will need to create interactive and engaging websites right from the beginning. 
You’ll begin by understanding the roles of front-end, back-end, and full-stack developers and how they collaborate, along with the terminology and skills essential for a web development career. 
Next, you’ll dive deep into HTML5—learning about structural elements like section, article, header, footer, and form controls such as input, fieldset, and legend. You’ll also explore the Document Object Model (DOM), scripting basics, and browser compatibility. 
Moving on to CSS, you’ll learn how to style and format web pages using selectors, IDs, and classes. You’ll explore layout tools like Flexbox and gain hands-on experience with responsive design using frameworks such as Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap. In JavaScript, you'll learn about variables, control structures, functions, prototypes, and how to interact with the DOM, along with practical experience using APIs and client-side scripting techniques to enhance user interaction. 
By learning the fundamentals of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, you will be able to combine them to: 
 - Create the basic structure of a website 
 - Create format and layout for web applications 
 - Enhance your website and create rich, interactive applications 
 - Increase user interactivity and enhance user experience 
 - Give your website a real wow factor! 
Throughout the course, you'll apply your learning through numerous hands-on labs and conclude with a final project where you'll build a webpage to showcase your skills and strengthen your portfolio.

movies.title: C for Everyone, Part 1: Programming Fundamentals
movies.description:
This course is for everyone. In the new world we live in, coding is a universally valuable skill, whether you're a scientist, artist, or a humanist. Algorithms are everywhere, and we all have to understand how they work. The C language is particularly well suited as an introduction to coding: It's a tried-and-true language, and it allows you to understand computing processes at a deep level. 
This course is the first part of a two-course sequence. It is a hands-on introduction to programming in C, designed to guide learners step by step from the basics of syntax and data types to more advanced concepts such as control flow, functions, recursion, arrays, and pointers. Through video lessons, quizzes, programming exercises, and real debugging tasks, learners build foundational concepts and good coding practices. By the end, learners will be able to write clear C programs, debug effectively, and build the knowledge base needed for more advanced computer science and software development.

movies.title: Scratch in Hindi
movies.description:
आज की दुनिया में कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग की समझ एक महत्वपूर्ण कौशल बन गयी है. कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग, जिसको कोडिंग भी कहते हैं, नियोजनीयता बढ़ाने में भी साकारत्मक भूमिका निभाती है। कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग करने से logical thinking भी विकसित होती है. 

कुछ वर्षों पहले, अमेरिका की MIT यूनिवर्सिटी के MIT Media Lab ने बच्चों में कोडिंग की रूचि जागृत करने के लिए Scratch नाम की एक फ्री सॉफ्टवेयर बनाई थी. Scratch अब बहुत प्रचलित हो गयी है और करोड़ों बच्चे, अध्यापक और अभिभावक आज Scratch के users हैं. 

Scratch में बहुत सरल block-based programming के ज़रिये आप मस्त games, animation और interactive stories इत्यादि बना सकते हैं. Scratch के नए version 3.0 में कई नए advanced features भी हैं जैसे Artificial Intelligence. 

इस वीडियो श्रृंखला में आप सीखेंगे free software Scratch में प्रोग्रामिंग.

movies.title: Excel Skills for Business: Advanced
movies.description:
This advanced Excel course is designed for business professionals, data analysts, and financial analysts seeking to master complex spreadsheet software for data-driven decision-making. Building on foundational Excel skills, this program will transform you into a power user, enhancing your employability and positioning you ahead in a rapidly evolving digital job market. (Source: World Economic Forum 2023 Future of Jobs Report).
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
- Master advanced Excel formulas and lookup functions for efficient data handling.
- Clean and prepare complex data for robust analysis using Microsoft Excel.
- Apply financial functions and date formulas for business calculations and reporting.
- Design and build professional, interactive dashboards in Excel for business intelligence.
To be successful, you should have completed the Excel Skills for Business: Essentials, Intermediate I, and Intermediate II courses, or possess equivalent intermediate Microsoft Excel proficiency.

movies.title: Car God Returns
movies.description: Apni asli pehchaan se anjaan ek talented mechanic ki zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab uski girlfriend usse dhokha de deti hai aur ek powerful CEO usse contract marriage kar leti hai. Jab sach saamne aata hai ki wahi desh ke sabse bade automobile empire ka asli waaris aur legendary "Car God" hai, to use apna haq wapas paane aur apne dushmano ko unki aukaat dikhani hoti hai.

movies.title: Desii Boy!!
movies.description: When Munna Fashionwala, the flamboyant yet grounded heir of the legendary Tartari gaon, arrives at Mumbai Fashion Week dressed like a village eccentric, the elite fashion world ridicules him. But as one humiliation after another turns into shocking revelations, Munna is forced into a battle of identity, heritage, and cultural pride against influencers, fashion tycoons, and global experts to prove that true fashion is born from roots, not trends.

movies.title: Return Of Lost Shehzada
movies.description: When the heir of a multi-trillion-crore empire finally awakens from a three-year coma, he discovers his devoted girlfriend and her family sacrificed everything to fund his secret treatment while enduring brutal humiliation from abusive relatives. Reunited with his ultra-powerful billionaire parents, the newly awakened CEO unleashes absolute vengeance on their tormentors and elevates his loyal bride to the peak of wealth and status.

movies.title: Not Your Family Man
movies.description: Micro Drama

movies.title: The Rising Son - From Shame to Supremacy
movies.description: Micro Drama

movies.title: Baazigaar Baaz
movies.description: "Baazigar Baaz" follows Dev, an elite commando known as Baaz, who attends his sister Diksha's engagement undercover in a peon's uniform. He endures extreme humiliation from her elitist fiancé, Vikas, to expose the man’s true nature. After uncovering Vikas’s fraud and infidelity, Dev reveals his identity, saves Diksha, and unites her with his trusted billionaire ally, Ambar Mehta.

movies.title: Guns & Gulab
movies.description:
This story is a high-voltage romantic thriller set against the backdrop of crime, power, and emotional conflict. It explores the journey of Naina, an innocent yet resilient girl, whose life takes a drastic turn when she crosses paths with Kabir Ahuja—a ruthless mafia don who falls obsessively in love with her.
The narrative blends intense romance with action, betrayal, and family drama. At its core, it questions morality, power dynamics, and the meaning of love—whether love can be forced or must be earned.
With strong emotional stakes, dramatic twists, and a dominating male protagonist versus a morally grounded female lead, the story promises a gripping mix of passion, revenge, and transformation.

movies.title: War God Ki Wapasi
movies.description: After returning home from war under absolute anonymity, a legendary, decorated commander known as the "War God" faces bitter rejection and humiliation from his estranged daughter and materialistic ex-wife. In the wake of this heartbreak, a powerful businesswoman from his past steps forward to defend his honor and accept him into her family.

movies.title: The Haunted Honeymoon
movies.description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika find themselves stalked by Malti , a beautiful, bloodthirsty spirit who wants one thing: possess Amey forever. Tension, gore and dark romance collide in this gripping horror saga.

movies.title: King in Disguise
movies.description: After a decade of risking his life to save others, billionaire heir Ved returns home only to be mistaken for a beggar. Humiliated, beaten, and forced to kneel by a greedy influencer and her ruthless brother—who are plotting to seize his family's empire—Ved silently endures everything to protect his sister. But when his true identity is revealed, their world is about to collapse.

movies.title: The Teen Queen
movies.description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. When billionaire heiress Tanisha Merchant hides her identity to live as an ordinary student, a poor girl, Mahira, is mistaken for the real heiress and embraces the lie. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

movies.title: Kaisa tera pyaar hai
movies.description: After enduring years of emotional abuse and violent humiliation as a secretary for his ungrateful secret love, an undercover AI prodigy resigns to claim his rightful throne as a tech company CEO—ultimately exposing his manipulative rival's fraudulent lies and leaving his deeply regretful former boss behind for a woman who truly values his worth.

movies.title: The Ancient Water Pot changed My Life
movies.description: After being betrayed and thrown out of his family, a wealthy young man discovers his mother’s magical water pot connects him to Lata, a village girl living in 1975. Using knowledge from the future, they transform each other’s lives and fall in love across 51 years. But when their connection is destroyed, Sahil discovers that the love he was searching for may have been beside him all along.

movies.title: Sauda Pyaar Ka
movies.description: Sauda Pyaar Ka is an emotional romance where a humble tailor secretly lives a double life as India's biggest fashion tycoon. While he sacrifices everything for the woman he loves, she betrays him for wealth and status—only to discover his true identity when it's too late. A story of love, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption.

movies.title: My PA is a Political Prince
movies.description:
My PA Is a Political Prince

Fearless activist Riya dreams of changing the world, unaware that her unpaid PA, Aryaman, is actually the heir to a powerful political dynasty. As love grows between them, ambitious politician Vikram pulls Riya into a dangerous world of fame and power. Torn between love and ambition, Riya must discover who truly stands by her before she loses everything.

movies.title: Mere Papa Heeralal
movies.description: When a self-made billionaire CEO is forced to fake a marriage with a poor lift mechanic to protect her son and save her empire, neither of them realizes that they are actually reunited lovers, the child's real parents, and heirs to a secret that will shake Mumbai's most powerful families.

movies.title: Love Beneath Paris Skies
movies.description: When a fiery billionaire heiress is forced to work with a rugged ex-army driver in Paris, their constant clashes turn into an unexpected romance. But as a ruthless family conspiracy, deadly attacks, and a shocking contract marriage threaten their lives and the Oberoi empire, they must decide whether to trust each other—or lose everything they love

movies.title: Satyamev Jayate
movies.description: Satyamev Singh, an undefeated lawyer who believes in the justice system, finds his world shattered when the criminal he defends destroys his own family. Now torn between his duty and personal pain, he must decide whether to trust the law or seek justice on his own.

movies.title: Final Breakup
movies.description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

movies.title: Payback for Parivaar
movies.description: The story revolves around Hardik, a man wrongfully accused of a crime against his own family. After spending years in jail, he returns with only one goal - to prove his innocence and expose the real culprit hiding within his family. Supported by Radhika, he begins a powerful journey of revenge, truth, and redemption. Watch now!

movies.title: Adha Pyar
movies.description: Chandni enters Somesh’s life pretending love but secretly plots with Rajiv to seize his empire. Through manipulation, murder, and betrayal, she destroys his family and leaves him broken. Surviving against all odds, Somesh uncovers their crimes, outsmarts them, and turns the game around. As greed and deceit consume Chandni and Rajiv, Somesh rises from “andha pyaar” to calculated revenge, ultimately reclaiming justice, family, and love.

movies.title: Mission Admission
movies.description: A billionaire father, Sudeep Sahani, disguises himself as a poor man to protect his daughter from humiliation in an elite school. As class prejudice, betrayal, and greed unfold, his ex-wife Anjana and her partner Tony try to exploit him. Sudeep exposes their truth, fights injustice, and challenges the system with his mission of equal education for all. Watch now.

movies.title: Delivery King
movies.description: A humble delivery man is mocked by everyone, but behind his ordinary appearance lies a business genius with unimaginable wealth and influence. As he repeatedly saves a powerful CEO from financial ruin, shocking secrets about his true identity leave his enemies stunned and his allies questioning everything.

movies.title: Cruel Attraction
movies.description: After being framed and imprisoned for a crime she didn't commit, Chandni returns home determined to find her missing younger sister. Forced into a dangerous deal with the notorious playboy Luv Rathore, she agrees to seduce his golden-boy brother Kush as part of a revenge scheme. But as buried secrets surface, Chandni discovers that one brother may be the villain everyone loves—and the other may be the devil willing to save her.

movies.title: Scientist Ki Waapsi
movies.description: When a brilliant but humble scientist is falsely accused by a fame-hungry influencer, he must fight a ruthless social media trial, powerful enemies, and public humiliation to reclaim his name and complete a mission that could change India's future.

movies.title: Ikka Number Paanch
movies.description: Young guy, who is a master of card games, reunites with his family who had discarded him years ago - and goes on to save them and their casino. There are multiple games involving card tricks, gambling themes where stakes are the highest - and our hero overcomes obstacles and wins them one by one.

movies.title: The Gangster King
movies.description: Veer is secretly a super powerful  and influential man controlling pokiticians and business men, while he pretends to be a cleaner - and ends up in a contract marriage with a businesswoman, whom he protects and gradually falls for. This businesswoman, Tara, faces problems created by her own family members along with a powerful and dangerous man - but Veer is too powerful and influential for all of them. He overpowers all the problems, while hiding his reality all this time.

movies.title: Khamosh Dil
movies.description: A passionate journalist, Akshat, loses his voice in an accident caused by his ambitious wife Twinkle, who soon begins to resent and humiliate him. As their marriage crumbles, Akshat rebuilds himself with the help of his childhood friend Reena, creating a revolutionary voice device. Rising from silence to success, he exposes betrayal, reclaims dignity, and finds his true voice.

movies.title: Dil Ka Encounter
movies.description: Dil Ka Encounter follows Ishaan Raghuvanshi, a haunted ex-sniper, and Sara Khanna, a billionaire’s daughter turned cadet after a life-changing rescue. Under a hidden identity, Sara joins a Special Forces academy—only to meet Ishaan, now broken and in hiding. As deception, rivalry, and power games unfold, a dangerous bond forms between them. This isn’t just action—it’s a battle between love and duty, past and redemption. Will Ishaan rise again… or lose everything once more? Watch now!

movies.title: Love ki Adaalat
movies.description: “Love Ki Adaalat” is a courtroom drama where justice battles power, manipulation, and emotions. When a poor fruit seller is blamed for an accident caused by a rich man, sharp lawyer Tanvi steps into a morally complex fight. As cases unfold, the courtroom becomes a stage for truth, love, and ethics, exposing how money and influence twist justice—and how courage can challenge it. Watch now.

movies.title: Super Dad Sunil Tyagi
movies.description: A scrap dealer secretly living as a billionaire tests his daughter’s strength and love. When her rich fiancé betrays and humiliates them, the truth is revealed—bringing justice, redemption, and proving that real wealth is character, not money.

movies.title: Meri Broken Family
movies.description: Micro Drama

movies.title: Million Dollar Mother [Hindi]
movies.description: The Mother Crown is a powerful family drama about love, sacrifice, and betrayal. Sangeeta, who raised three sons into a world-renowned doctor, businessman, and writer, finds her motherhood questioned when strangers claim she kidnapped them 25 years ago. As her sons turn against her, shocking truths and hidden powers surface—revealing that their entire success may not be their own, but the result of a mother’s secret crown.

movies.title: Khoon Ka Rishta [Hindi]
movies.description: When blind but brilliant photographer Zoya crosses paths with brooding businessman Yug Singhania, sparks fly in unexpected ways. As love blossoms through secrets, emotional wounds, and societal barriers, Zoya becomes Yug’s guiding light and he becomes her strength. Together, they discover that true vision comes not from the eyes, but from the heart.

movies.title: Mastermind Buddha
movies.description: Amit Garg sabke liye ek adhed umra ka aam mazdoor tha… uski apni family ne uski beizzati karke use marne ke liye chhod diya. CEO Meera khanna ne uski jaan bachakar use ek nayi zindagi di, par jab uski company tootne lagi, tabhi wahi 'mazdoor' uska sabse bada sahara bana. Jise sabne thukraya, usne sabko galat sabit kiya… kyunki sach yeh tha - Ki Amit ek chhupa hua scientist tha, jiska dimaag desh ke sabse bade aur khatarnak raaz likh raha tha.

movies.title: The Return of the Ultimate Mom
movies.description: Watch this show live on KuKuTV now!

movies.title: Raja Sahab Returns
movies.description: Surya, a former jailer and the secret kingpin of the coal mining empire, hides his true identity to give his son Adarsh a normal life. But when Adarsh is brutally humiliated, tortured, & kidnapped by the arrogant son of Surya’s own former ally, Surya is forced to step back into the world he left behind. As enemies try to destroy him and take over his empire, Surya returns as Raja Sahab,  not just to reclaim his throne, but to protect his son, destroy his enemies, & clean his empire from within.

movies.title: Bhai Ka Badla
movies.description: Kartik arrives into the family of Vivan, his sister Shivika and Dadaji, claiming that Kartik’s dad died saving Vivan when he was in a fatal accident with his parents, many years ago. Out of a sense of responsibility Shivika and dadaji decide to adopt Kartik but Vivan soon realises Kartik has ulterior motives. Kartik wants to oust Vivan from his own home and become the undeniable variz of the family.

movies.title: Shotgun Shaadi
movies.description: In the blood-soaked lands of Haryana, Abhimanyu Dahiya watches his father fall to the ruthless Sangwan clan and swears revenge. Years later, he returns in vengeance, destroying everything in his path… until fate binds him to Meher, his enemy’s daughter, in a marriage built on hatred. But when Abhimanyu discovers Meher is the very girl who once saved his life, his world shatters. Torn between his father’s blood and his own heart, he must choose - vengeance… or redemption. Watch Now!

movies.title: The Triple Crown
movies.description: After a fatal accident, a delivery boy is reincarnated as a weak scholar in an ancient village. Guided by a stylish genie, he must navigate a new life while married to a princess, a warrior, and a merchant’s daughter. Using modern knowledge and magical boons, he protects his home from bandits and corrupt soldiers. As he wins his wives' devotion, he transforms from a "mad bookworm" into a powerful, beloved ruler.

movies.title: Love under arrest
movies.description:
Romi and Shikha’s wedding turns tragic when her father accidentally injures Romi’s mother.
Blinded by anger, Romi turns his love into hatred and pushes Shikha away.
As Shikha battles illness and heartbreak, fate separates them further.
They reunite when she loses her memory, giving Romi a second chance.
Through love and redemption, he wins her back and they start anew.

movies.title: Pyar ka Turbulence
movies.description: A pregnant woman fights for her life on a turbulent flight—only to discover her pilot husband abandoning her for another woman. After losing her baby and being framed as a murderer, she rises from betrayal and heartbreak to reclaim her power… returning as a mysterious aviation titan determined to expose the lies that destroyed her life.

movies.title: Oops, Not a Gold Digger [Hindi]
movies.description:
A fearless delivery girl’s good deed spirals into an accidental marriage with a man she believes to be penniless—unaware he’s heir to a billionaire empire.
As family secrets, jealous rivals, and office politics threaten her dreams, she must fight for dignity, ambition, and love.
A tale of hidden identities, chaotic matchmaking, and an unexpected romance that could change her life forever.

movies.title: Kyunki Tum Hi Ho [Hindi]
movies.description: At the center is Shanaya Mehra, a woman trapped between a toxic husband Arjun Raichand and the scheming Rhea Malhotra, who will do anything to take her place. Every episode unfolds with high-voltage confrontations, tears, and shocking revelations—where loyalty is tested, lies unravel, and survival becomes Shanaya’s only fight.

movies.title: Ajnabi Rishta
movies.description:
Baby Loading Pyaar Pending is an engaging story of a pregnant college student, who fights stigma, poverty, and heartbreak while hiding a marriage born of sacrifice.
A powerful CEO unknowingly crosses paths with the wife he once rejected. Fate forces truth, redemption, and love to reunite a broken family. Watch now.

movies.title: Tapori Ki CEO Girlfriend
movies.description: A broke delivery rider, Uday, accidentally crosses paths with Sameera, a powerful CEO. A simple accident spirals into misunderstandings, street fights, unlikely friendships, and a contract marriage request that changes everything. As two worlds collide, Uday must navigate pride, poverty, and opportunity in a city where luck can flip in a heartbeat.

movies.title: Toofani Bodyguard
movies.description: A mysterious Kalaripayattu warrior, Krishna with a forgotten past becomes the shield of a brilliant pharma CEO, Rutvi who discovers a cancer cure - only to discover that their destinies, love, and a decades-old vendetta were bound long before fate reunited them. Watch now!

movies.title: Codename Pyaar
movies.description: Ek low-profile genius AI engineer, jise sab bewda aur muftkhor samajhte hain, asal mein India ki self-drive car ka asli hero hai—and jab system uske bina collapse karta hai, tab sach aur jhoot ka sabse khatarnaak test shuru hota hai.

movies.title: Unworthy Love
movies.description: Separated from his wealthy family after a childhood accident and raised in poverty, Navneet lives as a humble junk dealer while secretly rising to become a mysterious billionaire CEO. While hiding his elite identity to test the character of those around him, he must protect his long-lost mother and daughter from the greed and humiliation of arrogant socialites.

movies.title: Autowala Billionaire
movies.description: A billionaire couple goes undercover as poor to test their son’s character, only to watch him lose his values, fall for a toxic heiress, betray them — and eventually face a shocking truth that shatters every relationship. Watch now.

movies.title: Pyaar on Road
movies.description: A street-smart Jaipur Uber driver Prakriti and gentle empire heir Akshay Middha can’t stand each other, until a forced contract marriage slowly turns dislike into love, and boardroom conspiracies, jealous Suhani, and drug-running cousin Tanmay turn their fake vows into a deadly war for power and the heart. Watch now!

movies.title: Clumsy Love [Hindi]
movies.description: Clumsy Love

movies.title: Jamai on EMI [Hindi]
movies.description: Betrayed on her engagement day, Maira Ramani impulsively fakes a relationship with Naksh, the charming hotel owner with secrets of his own. What begins as a deal to save face and secure family inheritances soon spirals into a complicated web of emotions, lies, and unexpected love. Will their fake marriage turn into something real?

movies.title: Crorepati ki Contract Wife
movies.description: When fiery Maya Sinha crosses paths with ruthless billionaire lawyer Sameer Malhotra, sparks fly. Between betrayal by her ex Raj and her fight to save her father, Maya discovers that the cold-hearted tycoon’s guarded heart may just belong to her. Watch Now!

movies.title: Who picked Mr. Fu's Rose [Hindi]
movies.description: Who picked Mr. Fu's Rose

movies.title: Ajnabi ka Intezar Hai
movies.description: A broken woman, robbed of motherhood, finds unexpected love in a humble construction worker—unaware he’s a secret billionaire hiding his true identity. As their fragile romance deepens, dark secrets, betrayal, and a stolen child resurface, forcing them to fight against fate, enemies, and shattered trust to claim the family they were destined for.

movies.title: Bulletproof Ishq
movies.description:
A feared builder RD's life is saved by an innocent girl, Heer sparking a bond that turns dangerously intimate.
 As she uncovers his son’s betrayal, she becomes the target of brutal humiliation and cruelty. When she hits rock bottom, the man she saved rises as her protector, exposing a truth that shatters his own family.  In the end, love survives but only after betrayal, blood, and a legacy destroyed from within.

movies.title: Mai Jhoota Tu Jhooti
movies.description: Two childhood lovers reunite and rush into marriage, believing they’ve found love beyond money. But there’s a twist—both are secretly billionaires, pretending to be poor. As lies pile up, their relationship is tested by ego, humiliation, and hidden truths. When reality finally hits, will their love survive the biggest secret of all… or shatter forever?

movies.title: Bade Miyaan Deewane
movies.description: In a famine-stricken kingdom of Bhopal, on the brink of war in 1981, a starving old man Bundu Khan discovers a mysterious spirit that grants his deepest wishes. To escape being sent to die in battle, he impulsively marries three cousin sisters and promises them safety. But as Bundu grows younger and stronger with every act of love and compassion, enemies, betrayal, and war close in—testing whether this unlikely family can survive together. Watch Now!

movies.title: Baazigar O Baazigar
movies.description: A rising rockstar believes he achieved fame through his own talent until the woman who silently built his career walks out of his life, forcing him to confront the truth about love, ambition, and the cost of betrayal.

movies.title: Boss Ishqq aur Deal
movies.description: A divorced single mother, Isha, lies to become the PA of billionaire Karan Ahuja to save her daughter’s custody. What begins as hatred, ego clashes, and a reckless bet slowly turns into love. But conspiracies, betrayals, and deadly attacks threaten to destroy everything. Watch now.

movies.title: Billionaire Doctor Ka Ishq
movies.description: Manisha’s life is shattered when she discovers she is pregnant after being drugged and spending a night with a stranger. As fear and confusion give way to shocking truth, she learns the man involved is a powerful billionaire. Caught between trauma, secrecy, and social judgment, Manisha must navigate a world that questions her character while she struggles to reclaim control over her body, dignity, and future.

movies.title: Arranged to Love
movies.description: A billionaire businessman, Vikram Singhania, has to enter into an arranged marriage with Dr. Bhoomi Arora because of family pressure. What starts as a cold, forced marriage slowly transforms into an unexpected journey of trust, passion, and love. Arranged to Love is a romantic drama where duty collides with desire, and two strangers must decide if their hearts can truly meet.

movies.title: Love Gamble
movies.description: Love Gamble is a drama mini-series that follows the unlikely connection between a wealthy nightclub owner and a struggling young woman. The story begins when Litika, a homeless woman, rescues an expensive watch belonging to Nishant Singhaniya, a powerful club owner. Grateful and intrigued, Nishant brings Litika into his world, offering her a job and a place to stay.

movies.title: Don In Uniform
movies.description: Yash, ek underworld don, school ke ladke Rahul ko bachate hue maara gaya, aur uski aatma Rahul ke andar bas gayi. Kamzor aur bechaara Rahul, jise sab kam aankte the, ab Yash ki taakat aur swag ke saath badalne laga. Yash ne Rahul ko sambhalne aur uska graduation ka sapna poora karne ka faisla kiya. School mein Rahul hero ban gaya, ladkiyan uske charm ki deewani ho gayi. Lekin padhai aur beeta hua past uske liye badi chunauti ban gaye. Kahi Yash Rahul ko apni tarah criminal to nahi bana dega?

movies.title: Lady Boss Returns
movies.description:
My Boss Lady is a modern romantic drama set against the glittering world of luxury hotels, real estate empires, and high-stakes corporate alliances.
 It explores love, betrayal, and revenge through the journey of Kiara Bhansali, a self-made billionaire who hides her identity to test loyalty and integrity — and ends up meeting Tej Jaisingh, an ambitious CEO caught between love and legacy.
Their accidental meeting spirals into a whirlwind of mistaken identities, class clashes, fake marriages, and boardroom battles — until Kiara’s true power as the “Sky Queen” turns the game upside down.
 The series balances romantic comedy, emotional redemption, and corporate intrigue, delivering a story about a woman reclaiming love and respect on her own terms.

movies.title: Beghar Billionaire
movies.description: Armaan Raheja, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kashish, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

movies.title: Sorry! Not a Gold Digger
movies.description: When hardworking delivery girl Tara crosses paths with billionaire heir Rohan Mehta through a twist of fate, their unexpected flash marriage sparks a journey filled with secrets, clashes, and unspoken love. As Tara struggles to protect her dignity and dreams, and Rohan hides his true identity, will this unlikely union blossom into real love or collapse under lies and pride? Watch Now!

movies.title: Pyar Dhoka or Promotion
movies.description:
In the glamorous yet cutthroat world of corporate power, secrets are the ultimate currency. Simran and Purab, two high-profile executives, are bound by a marriage they keep hidden from the very empire they run thanks to strict company policies. But behind closed doors, their relationship is on the verge of collapse.

Enter Veer and Tanya, ambitious new interns who quickly realize that charm can be just as powerful as talent.

movies.title: Billionaire Bana Fake boyfriend [Hindi]
movies.description: A billionaire disguises himself as a beggar to find true love and ends up in a fake relationship with a wealthy heiress, who’s being forced by her family to marry a spoiled billionaire.

movies.title: Time Travel [Hindi]
movies.description: After betrayal and heartbreak, Rahul mysteriously travels back in time, determined to change his fate, save his family, and protect Alia from powerful enemies only to discover that altering the past comes with dangerous new consequences. Watch Now!

movies.title: We, the Emperor
movies.description: Watch "We, the Emperor" Only On KUKKU TV!

movies.title: The Hidden Waris
movies.description: A self-made tycoon, Deep Shah, hides his roots as the son of a humble security guard. When his father arrives in Mumbai, he’s brutally humiliated by the same elite world Deep now rules. As truth unravels, power flips—exposing class arrogance, testing loyalty, and setting the stage for a ruthless reckoning.

movies.title: The Richest Bank Robber
movies.description: When billionaire Adarsh Sharma returns to India, a sudden accident leaves his parents critically injured. Stripped of proof of identity, he is ridiculed and denied access to his own wealth. As time runs out, desperation turns into rebellion, forcing him into a daring heist of his own bank. Amid greed, ego, and injustice, the story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, identity, and moral reckoning. Watch Now.

movies.title: Billionaire's Journey From Kanpur To London
movies.description: A secret billionaire endures years of abuse from his ungrateful wife in London before reclaiming his Indian empire and a new life. After a high-stakes plane crisis, he finds true love with a kind flight attendant who respected him even when he posed as a lowly cleaner. When his bankrupt ex-wife unknowingly returns to beg for his investment, she is publicly exposed and disgraced. The humble hero and his new queen ultimately unite their worlds of immense wealth and rural tradition.

movies.title: God Of Cricket
movies.description: A Janitor is a hidden fireball bowler who saves a cricket team from losing the Delhi premiere league.

movies.title: Desh ka Dhurandhar
movies.description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.

movies.title: CEO's Magical Bodyguard
movies.description: Chirag Chauhan lives as an ordinary man, hiding the truth that he is the last disciple of the legendary yogi Neeldev. When he saves Nimisha, the fearless chairperson of the Nandini Group, destiny places him as her personal bodyguard. Between power struggles, betrayal, a forced contract marriage, and rising enemies, Chirag must protect Nimisha while keeping his divine identity secret until fate forces him to reveal his true strength.

movies.title: The Undercover Lady CEO
movies.description: When TerraGem’s young VP Alisha Talwar goes undercover as an intern to expose a massive money-fraud, a ruthless social climber, Reva, steals her identity as “Mrs. Talwar” and turns the office into a bullying circus. To save her marriage, her company—and her own name—Alisha must outplay the impostor and catch the laundering ring before it destroys her.

movies.title: Commando Panther
movies.description: A decorated special forces commander, living incognito as a mechanic to escape his traumatic past, finds his secret life upended when he falls for a powerful CEO, forcing him to confront old enemies, a web of corporate conspiracies, and his own guilt to protect his new love and reclaim his destiny. Watch now.

movies.title: Social Media ka Billionaire
movies.description: A humble pizza delivery boy discovers he is the secret heir to an 8,000-crore empire but instead of revealing the truth, he chooses to stay poor and test the world that humiliated him.

movies.title: Ready Daddy Go!
movies.description: One night, a strict corporate father and his rebellious teenage son mysteriously swap souls — forcing the dad to survive high school drama and the son to run a high-pressure office — only to discover that walking in each other’s shoes might be the only way to fix their broken bond.

movies.title: Billionaire ka Safar
movies.description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

movies.title: CEO Bana Ghar Jamai
movies.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

movies.title: Breakup Se Bana Billionaire
movies.description: After being dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, struggling techie Aditya impulsively marries a stranger, Preeti, unaware she is a billionaire CEO. What begins as a deal-driven marriage turns explosive when Aditya is revealed to be the long-lost heir of a powerful business family, and the very man who humiliated him becomes his rival. As love, identity, and ambition collide, Aditya must choose between revenge, legacy, and the woman who believed in him first.

movies.title: Ek Anjana Rishta
movies.description: Seven years after Diwali destroyed his life, billionaire Samrat Singh lives in guilt, believing his wife Shreya and their unborn child died in a tragic accident caused by his powerful father’s cruelty. Unknown to him, Shreya survived—left paralysed, traumatised, and living on the streets with her young daughter Jiya, who grows up scavenging bottles to keep her mother alive. Fate cruelly reunites them when Jiya steals Samrat’s ring to fund Shreya’s life-saving surgery, leading to humiliation, conflict, and heartbreak before the truth finally surfaces: Jiya is Samrat’s daughter, and Shreya is alive. As love, guilt, and redemption collide amid social cruelty and class divides, Aakhri Diya becomes a story of lost love, a child’s hope, and a broken family finding its way back to light.

movies.title: Billionaire Bhikari [Hindi]
movies.description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Bhikari is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

movies.title: Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions [Hindi]
movies.description: "Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions" A wealthy young heir sets out to “audition” potential father figures to inherit his fortune. As eccentric candidates compete for the role, hidden motives, heartfelt bonds, and unexpected twists blur the line between family and fortune.

movies.title: Oops, It Was My Husband [Hindi]
movies.description: Three years after a contract marriage, ambitious designer Isha Shrivastava unexpectedly crosses paths with her estranged husband, billionaire Nitin Mehta the man she never really knew. What begins as a fake relationship to escape family debts spirals into real emotions, shocking secrets, and a second chance at love neither of them saw coming. Watch Now!

movies.title: Nakli Pati Nikla Crorepati [Hindi]
movies.description: Lakshya Oberoi—India’s youngest billionaire—was never meant to be anyone’s husband. But a one-night stand with fiery Tanya Goenka traps him in a dangerous contract marriage built on lies, lust, and survival. As Tanya battles her scheming stepmother, jealous stepsister and ruthless ex-fiancé, secrets unravel and enemies close in. In a world of stolen identities and deadly conspiracies, Lakshya must decide if Tanya is his greatest weakness—or the only ally who can save him.

movies.title: My Accidental Royal Husband [Hindi]
movies.description: In a twist of fate, a common woman accidentally marries a royal heir, unaware of his true identity. As she navigates palace intrigue and royal duties, their bond deepens, leading her to discover unexpected love and power.

movies.title: Queen Of Snakes
movies.description: Devika thought she had found love, only to discover her husband, Vikrant, was a prince who conspired to destroy her unborn child. Brutalized by his lawful wife and carrying the bloodline of an enemy who wiped out her village, Devika was forced to embrace her identity as a powerful Naag Kanya. As ancient curses flared, she watched her betrayers rot from within, proving that no one escapes the bite of karma.

movies.title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
movies.description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

movies.title: The Hidden Boss
movies.description: A billionaire CEO, Manav, secretly fakes his own downfall to trap his rival, Karan. On his wedding day, he’s publicly humiliated as “bankrupt,” and his new wife Ritika’s family turns against him. Despite insults and betrayal, Manav silently endures, hiding the truth as he tests love, loyalty, and prepares a powerful comeback.

movies.title: Unknown Connection
movies.description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonal secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her "family," while Sonal's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonal's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.

movies.title: Aa Nimisham
movies.description:
A young man’s life changes forever after a tragic accident draws him into a mysterious household. As secrets, lies, and hidden motives unfold, he must confront love, betrayal, and his own haunted past.
Aa Nimisham is an emotional thriller where every moment holds a revelation — and nothing is as it seems.

movies.title: Just Divorced
movies.description:
A poor but self-respecting girl discovers that her absentee father is a powerful billionaire who refuses to acknowledge her.
Public humiliation, betrayal, and emotional abandonment shatter her childhood belief in love and family.
As a mother-daughter duo walks away from injustice, fate begins to test the father with guilt, loss, and truth.
This is the story of broken promises, hidden identities, and a daughter who refuses to beg for her father’s love.

movies.title: Betrayed Heiress
movies.description: Sakshi, who sacrificed everything for love, faces betrayal from her husband Vansh and his family. Humiliated and deceived, she rises with courage, reveals her true identity as the heir of SB Group, and reclaims her dignity and power.

movies.title: Secret Legend [Hindi]
movies.description: When humble masseur Veer Jindal is humiliated by his wife Simran and her family, they have no idea he is secretly the billionaire chairman of the powerful Choksi Group. As betrayals unfold and family ties are tested, Veer’s hidden identity shakes their world, exposing greed, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Watch Now!

movies.title: Royal Betrayal [Hindi]
movies.description: In the chaos of a deadly warzone, a woman crosses paths with the royal heir who shattered her heart — now forced to trust him for survival. As danger closes in, love and revenge collide in a race against death.

movies.title: College Romance Aur Dhoka
movies.description: College Romance

movies.title: Brahmrakshas
movies.description: When a wedding in the silent village of Dhumgarh breaks an ancient taboo against noise, a curse awakens—the vengeful spirit of Dev, a once-noble scholar betrayed in love and transformed into the dreaded Brahmrakshas. As brides mysteriously vanish, Ira, a fearless paranormal expert, arrives to uncover the truth.

movies.title: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha
movies.description: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha ek intense relationship thriller hai jo marriage, infidelity aur obsession ke dark side ko explore karta hai. Yeh kahani ek aurat ke tootne aur phir apne aap ko dobara khada karne ki journey hai. Show poochta hai—kya pyaar ke naam par har zulm maaf ho sakta hai? Aur jab ek aurat apni had se aage badh jaaye, toh kya woh victim rehti hai ya hunter ban jaati hai?

movies.title: Brother Betrayal
movies.description: Alok Upadhyay, a noble elder brother, sacrifices everything to secure a bright future for his younger brother Rohan. But as Alok rises to power with the support of his devoted wife Anita and strong-willed daughter Aditi, Rohan, twisted by greed and fueled by his arrogant wife Diya, betrays the very family that gave him everything. A tale of sacrifice, ambition, and the tragic downfall of brotherhood.

movies.title: The Ultimate Return
movies.description: The Ultimate Return is a high-octane power drama where a man written off as a loser is revealed as Leo—the unseen kingmaker controlling billion-dollar empires. As ruthless heirs, corrupt elites, and broken relationships collide, love, ambition, and revenge play out in a brutal succession battle where power bows only to truth and courage.

movies.title: My Crazy Ex-Girlfriend
movies.description: Hardik Goyal’s perfect life collapses when he loses his company, reputation, and fiancée overnight. Betrayed and broken, fate pulls him into the shadowy world of the mafia, where power replaces principles. As danger escalates, Hardik reconnects with Niharika, his childhood savior, discovering love, strength, and destiny. Choosing the mafia becomes his only way to protect love, family, and his future.

movies.title: Paralysed Dulha [Hindi]
movies.description: Boss, Open Up Your Eyes is a high-stakes drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. When Swati is forced into a contract marriage with Abhinav, a powerful heir who wakes up from a coma, secrets begin to unravel—her true identity, his family’s ruthless motives, and a dangerous game of power. Between manipulation, revenge, and unexpected emotions, both must decide whether this marriage will destroy them or become their greatest strength.

movies.title: The Layoff That Shook the Company [Hindi]
movies.description: In a high-stakes world of corporate power and betrayal, former tech prodigy Ethan finds himself caught between loyalty and revenge. As the mighty Blackwell Group crumbles due to internal politics and personal vendettas, Ethan must decide whether to save the empire that wronged him—or let it burn. A gripping tale of ambition, heartbreak, and redemption in the ruthless tech industry.

movies.title: One Last Chance [Hindi]
movies.description:
One Last Chance is a gripping tale of love, choices, and the price of regret. A woman walks away from true love, only to realize later what she lost - as the man she left behind rebuilds his life in a deeply loving and affluent relationship. Passion, heartbreak, and high-stakes emotions collide in this drama that will keep you hooked at every turn.

An emotional rollercoaster and one of the most interesting watches of the year.

movies.title: Lost In Love [Hindi]
movies.description: Jab pyaar sirf ek emotion nahi, balki ek dangerous game ban jaata hai, tab har rishta ek nayi twist leta hai. Elle, Ethan aur Jannette ke beech ka yeh triangle sirf love story nahi, ek intense emotional rollercoaster hai jahan trust, betrayal aur revenge sab kuch hai. To ready ho jao ek gripping kahani ke liye jo har episode ke saath aur complicated hoti jaati hai. Abhi dekhna shuru kijiye.

movies.title: Sweet Revenge
movies.description: Sweet Revenge is a dramatic tale of love, betrayal, and justice. Rachit, a devoted husband and real author behind his wife Prerna’s success, sacrifices everything for her—only to be cheated, framed, and abandoned. As truth unfolds, Rachit rises to reclaim his identity, expose deceit, and find true love, while Prerna faces the consequences of her greed. Watch now.

movies.title: The Billionaire Servant
movies.description: “A humble, soft-spoken man is brutally wronged by powerful enemies, forcing him to shed his innocence and rise as a fearless force of justice. As Ram transforms into Avtar, he challenges corruption, family betrayal, and social cruelty—becoming the protector the helpless prayed for.”

movies.title: Gun, Gangster Aur Good Boy
movies.description:
Mafia Girl is a high-voltage romantic crime drama with dark humor and emotional depth.
Mayra, who rules the underworld with fear, experiences love for the first time—with a man who has nothing but honesty.
Sunny, always exploited and underestimated, finally becomes someone worth fighting for.
The show explores class divide, toxic love, power politics, and emotional manipulation.
Every episode blends romance, danger, and drama with shocking twists.
At its heart, it asks—can love survive when it is born in violence?

movies.title: Joker Ka Wild Card
movies.description: Varun looks like a harmless, childlike man who has lost his memory, but behind that innocence lies a mysterious past and terrifying skill. When a ruthless gambling syndicate traps his wife’s family in an 8-crore debt, Varun steps onto the gambling table himself. With brilliant tricks and fearless mind games, he begins exposing the cheats of the underworld. But who is Varun really… and why does the gambling world fear the name Sikandar?

movies.title: My Commando Wife
movies.description: A humiliated housewife, secretly a legendary Marine Commando presumed to be a myth, rises from betrayal and erasure to reclaim her identity, destroy the family that discarded her, and prove that the woman they broke is the very warrior they were never worthy of.

movies.title: The Miracle Surgeon
movies.description: A selfless man who sacrifices his legendary medical career to become a househusband for his wife and daughter is humiliated, cheated on, and brutally divorced only to lose custody of the child he raised as his own. Years later when he returns as India’s most celebrated surgeon, the very medical genius the world worships. Fate pits him against his past when the child he loved faces a life-or-death surgery—and the family who destroyed him must now beg the man they once crushed to save her life

movies.title: Dulhan Se Darling
movies.description: Dulhan Se Darling is a fiery romantic drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Kritika Reddy, heiress of a billion-dollar empire disguised as a cleaning staff, crosses paths with ruthless billionaire Rihaan Bhatt, sparking a storm of clashes, secrets, and undeniable attraction. But when her duplicitous fiancé and his mistress plot against her, Kritika must rise from humiliation to power—finding both revenge and unexpected love.

movies.title: The Billionaire Returns Home
movies.description: Riyansh Singhaniya, a billionaire CEO travels to a small town to buy land for his first mall—only to discover that an old, struggling couple refusing to sell may actually be his long-lost parents. Going undercover as a common man, he witnesses their poverty, humiliation, and the cruelty of their greedy relatives.

movies.title: Undercover Agent: Mission Narmada Jail
movies.description: A disgraced RAW commando infiltrates a high-security Indian prison to expose a terror network, but discovers the man who ruined his father’s name and his nation’s honour has been hiding in the same cell all along.

movies.description: Billionaire is mistaken as a Delivery Boy.

movies.title: Secret Prince
movies.description: So, our hero, born into a super-rich family, is about to be named the next heir to their business empire. But according to their family tradition, the person taking the position has to learn the ropes for 3 months by working at another business, hiding their real identity. That's exactly what our hero does.. He hides who he is and starts working at a business family's place. That's where he meets our heroine, who's already engaged to someone else. Love starts blooming in his heart, too. Now, what's our hero going to do? Is he going to stick to the family tradition? Or is he going to give up the family's custom to marry his girlfriend

With every calculated smile, every lingering touch, she stepped deeper into his marriage—turning boardroom meetings into battles of desire, and home into a war zone. But how far would she go? To steal his property? To wear his wife’s crown? Or to seduce her way into a future where his empire bore her name alone?

movies.title: Mafia's Innocent Bride [Tamil]
movies.description:
Don David rules the dark underworld of Chennai. His word is law, his eyes spell death.

When Meera is pulled into his ruthless world, she faces blood, betrayal, and revenge at every turn.

The throne of power is up for grabs. The war has just begun. 🔥

Every moment a riddle. Every scene a shock. Witness it Now!

movies.description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Veer, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Vaishali due to family greed and betrayal, turning two broken lives into an unlikely partnership. As conspiracies, poison plots, and humiliation surround them, Veer secretly uses his powers to protect Shaifali, while love slowly grows between duty, dignity, and destiny.

movies.title: Billionaire Became Beggar
movies.description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Became Beggar is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

movies.title: The Great Indian Cook
movies.description:
Samy and Sarath are childhood friends, but their sons, Kathir and Dev, become rivals at the family restaurant. After Samy leaves and Sarath dies, Dev blames Kathir, while Kathir rises from a small roadside stall with his talent.
When they face each other on the Great Indian Kitchen stage, will jealousy win, or will true talent prove itself?

movies.title: The Billionaire's Deal
movies.description: The Billionaire's Deal is a modern love-hate saga between Yukanika , a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant , a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Yukanika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!

movies.title: Mechanic Billa: Return of the Racing Legend
movies.description: After five years in hiding, a legendary racer disguised as a mechanic must return to the track to save his village, igniting a high-octane rivalry with the current world champion. Watch now!

movies.title: The Ba***ds of Boardroom [Tamil]
movies.description: The Ba***ds of Boardroom is an engaging story of a mother sacrifices everything to raise a child she believes is hers. Betrayal, greed, and blood ties collide inside boardrooms and bedrooms alike. When the final chess move is revealed, only one woman stands victorious. Watch now.

movies.title: Me and My Sister [Tamil]
movies.description: ஒரு போர்ல நல்லா அனுபவப்பட்ட ஒரு சோல்ஜர், ஒரு அழகான, பவர்ஃபுல் CEO-க்கு பர்சனல் பாடி கார்டா மாறறான். மறைஞ்சிருக்கும் ஆபத்துல இருந்து அவளைக் காப்பாத்துறான், அதே நேரம் பெரிய சதித்திட்டங்களையும் கண்டுபிடிக்கிறான். இந்த குழப்பத்துக்கு நடுவுல காதல் மலர, அவனோட பலமும் விசுவாசமும் கொடூரமான எதிரிகள், அப்புறம் கார்ப்பரேட் சதிக்கு எதிரா சோதிக்கப்படுது..அந்த சோதனையில இருந்து தப்பிச்சானா??

He visits them for his father in-law’s birthday celebration where they demean and insult him. Will he finally reveal his true identity during this crisis? Watch Now !

movies.title: Billionaire Heist
movies.description: A billionaire with unlimited funds but no proof, Dharam Khurana is trapped in a system that refuses to believe him. As hours tick down and humiliation piles up, one decision changes everything. What begins as a simple plea turns into a dangerous game of power, ego, and survival.

movies.description: Rented Husband

movies.description: Divya returns to Chennai hiding her true identity. Betrayed and publicly humiliated by her lover Guru, she is pushed to the edge. A chance encounter with Kishore, a powerful CEO fighting his own battles, changes everything. When Divya’s real strength is revealed, those who mocked her are left helpless. This is the rise of a true Lady Boss.

movies.title: My Husband Is A Ghost Hunter
movies.description: Naina , a widowed gold magnate, marries Arjun Varma to protect her daughter and her collapsing empire, believing he is only a broken ex-convict. When powerful gold syndicates attack her business and target her child, a buried truth explodes. Her husband Arjun Varma is actually Ghost Hunter, a man once feared by governments and erased from history. As a contract marriage turns real, a caged monster rises to protect his family and claim his throne.

movies.title: Study God [Tamil]

series.title: The Altruists [Hindi]
series.description: Follows the tumultuous romance between FTX co-founder Sam Bankman-Fried and his girlfriend Caroline Ellison. It depicts their ambitious attempts to revolutionize the financial system, leading to a $36 billion fraud.

series.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians [Hindi]
series.description: Demigod Percy Jackson leads a quest across America to prevent a war among the Olympian gods.

series.title: Yellowjackets [Hindi]
series.description: A wildly talented girls high school soccer team become the unlucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness.

series.title: Play with Fire [Hindi]
series.description: When Alex starts to get bored with his life with his wife Lara, and tries to find a beautiful escape, he meets Nadine who is also trapped in a complicated relationship with her husband, Erwin.

series.title: Good Partner [Hindi]
series.description: Cold and hot human court office drama between Cha Eun-kyeong (Jang Na-ra), a star lawyer whose divorce is her calling, and Han Yoo-ri (Nam Ji-hyun), a new lawyer whose divorce is her first time.

series.title: The Blue Road [Hindi]
series.description: Two detectives pursue a killer leaving mutilated bodies and cryptic messages across Japan and Korea. Korean text appears with Tokyo victims, Japanese with Korean victims, leading to an international manhunt.

series.title: Dig [Hindi]
series.description: Follows four women at an archaeological dig in Greece, each facing different life challenges. When they discover a buried secret that could change history, they become entangled in a dangerous international conspiracy.

series.title: CoComelon Lane
series.description: The adventures of JJ and his friends as they experience life as little kids.

series.title: The Detective Is Already Dead [Hindi]
series.description: Kimizuka Kimihiko is a crisis-magnet. From getting caught up in a crime scene to accidentally witnessing a drug deal, trouble seems to find him around every corner. So it is no surprise when his rather mundane flight suddenly enters a state of emergency with a dire need of a detective onboard. Unfortunately, his attempt at avoiding trouble is foiled by a beautiful girl with silver hair who goes by the codename Siesta. Declaring herself a detective, she unceremoniously drags Kimizuka into the case as her assistant. That incident spelled the beginning of an adventure around the globe that went beyond his wildest imagination. Putting their lives on the line, the two took down criminal organizations, prevented disasters, and saved thousands. But the curtain closed to their epic journey with Siesta's untimely death three years later. Resolving to live an ordinary high school life this time, Kimizuka spends a year maintaining a low profile. However, as fate would have it, a girl with an uncanny resemblance to Siesta comes crashing into his life, threatening to throw his peaceful days into disarray.

series.title: Still a Family
series.description: In 2015, Tongzhou officially became the sub-center of Beijing, and the people were very happy. Sai Duoxi's family, who lived in the alley of the old wharf of the North Canal and were doing renovation, received the demolition payment as promised. The five brothers and sisters of the Sai family quarreled over the demolition payment. In the process, the hidden problems of each family were exposed one after another. Sai Duoxi was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Facing his children who were like a pile of scattered sand, he was always unable to treat them equally, and he fell into distress and reflection. His greatest wish was to see his children live in harmony before he died, and this hope could only be placed on his eldest daughter-in-law Wen Jiayin. Wen Jiayin, the eldest sister-in-law who was always gentle and docile but determined in her heart, began to clean up the "mess" of the Sai family in the name of her family. With her efforts and inspiration, the five brothers and sisters finally corrected their shortcomings according to their father's expectations, united, turned danger into safety, and realized their father's long-cherished wish of "family harmony brings prosperity".

series.title: Miracles of the ER
series.description: Zhou Cheng-jun, deputy director of emergency medicine, brings an average graduate into his elite team. Together with Dr. He Ya-hua, they face relentless medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and internal power struggles at the hospital.

series.title: Dream
series.description: Years ago, journalist Shen Yueshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now, she returns to Lacheng, picking up her camera again to explore those corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian were once the protagonists of her lens, yet their fates have been shaped by the passage of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time, and Shen Yueshui travels between the past and the present, uncovering these long-forgotten tales.

series.title: Spring of the Blade
series.description: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

series.description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus.

episodes.title: Apotheosis
episodes.description: Zen Luo, who is now a menial slave, used to be a young master of a big family, owing to the decline of his family, his sister is imprisoned by a strong force, he has no choice but to be at others' service. However, Every cloud has a silver lining, The ancient book left by his father actually conceals the magical spell, which can change a human into an instrument. What's the mysterious power behind all these? This is contest with fate.

episodes.title: The First Jasmine
episodes.description: Li Ye marries Xiuyao Mo while her sister Ying Ye weds Li Ye's childhood friend Jingli Mo. Sealed on Mount Li for eight years, Li Ye secretly avenges officials who harmed her home. She and Xiuyao unite to help emperor defeat conspiracies.

episodes.title: City of Romance [Hindi]
episodes.description: Bai Xiao Duo, who hides behind lies due to low self-esteem, meets Su Yan Cheng, a genius cartoonist who despises lies. Despite their differences, they heal each other through a series of events, gradually mending their inner wounds.

episodes.title: The Legends
episodes.description: a hilarious and sweet xianxia romance set in Ancient China, Lu Zhao Yao went through life living ostentatiously in every way possible. She lived her entire demon life in a loud and brazen manner, reigning over legions of demons, and yet----just before she was about to retrieve the sword of the ancient demon king and rightfully claim her spot on the throne
